wikidata.note: Confirmed by label: 'Sentiero Laguna de los Tres' (it), the trail itself, with a Laguna de Los Tres image; the item has no coordinates, so a person should re-check it.

draw.note: The national tourism board's top list names it 'para la postal icónica'; the municipal board calls it one of the most important treks in El Chaltén; inside the Los Glaciares WHS (parent).

standing.note: The headline day hike of El Chaltén on both the national and municipal boards.

records.standing_scope: El Chaltén and the north zone of Los Glaciares

distinction.note: Laguna Torre (about 7 km away) is the same class under Cerro Torre; Base Torres in Torres del Paine (about 250 km) is the nearest comparable spire-and-lake hike.

records.unique_because: The closest walkers get to the east face of Fitz Roy

easy_payoff.note: Laguna Capri, on the same trail, gives Fitz Roy over water at about a third of the effort, but not the face up close.

weather.note: The payoff is the Fitz Roy face, which disappears in cloud; wind makes the final climb unsafe.

records.why: The classic Fitz Roy view from the lake at its foot, the hardest and best day hike in El Chaltén.

access_cost.note: Only the park entry ticket, bought online and shown as a QR code; no cap, slot or permit found.

weather.note: The ice is impressive under grey sky; rain makes the grating slippery.

records.why: A 5 km-wide glacier front calving into Lago Argentino, seen from railed walkways.
